FN-W1BDB5E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 117
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Government
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 117 as introduced could decrease the obligation of the county commissions by an
undetermined amount dependent on the difference in the cost of any services purchased through
a county procurement program and the cost of such services otherwise procured under current
law.
This bill could also authorize county commissions to adopt a procurement program that provides
significant administrative savings, instead of only cost savings, as provided by current law.
Page 1
